definitions.explanation: A particular part of a country, city, or larger geographical area.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{地域|ちいき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{地域|ちいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{交流|こうりゅう}している→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧。
examples.english: I interact with people in the community.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{地域|ちいき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This area has a festival every year.

notes:
{地域|ちいき} refers to a defined geographical area or region. It can range from a local neighborhood to a larger area.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {地域|ちいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧: local people
- {地域|ちいき}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: local community
- {地域|ちいき}⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧: local residents
- {地域|ちいき}⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: community activities

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{地区|ちく}→地区：03463_chiku⟧: district (more administrative)
- ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧: region, province (larger scale)
- ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧: one's local area, hometown
- ⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧: neighborhood (immediate vicinity)

{地域|ちいき} is often used in compound words: {地域|ちいき}⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧ (regional healthcare), {地域|ちいき}⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧ (regional economy).
